title: WHEN YOU WAKE BEFORE DAWN
PRAYER FOR AN ANXIOUS MIND
end: The Morning Altar — begin every sunrise in prayer

scenes.a: You woke up before the sun today because your mind would not stop racing.
I prevented the dawning of the morning, and cried: I hoped in thy word.
Lord, before this day demands anything from us, we lift our eyes to You in the quiet dark.
You know the worries that woke us early and the burdens we carry into the dawn.
Place Your gentle peace deep inside our hearts and anchor our hope in Your eternal promises.
Subscribe to The Morning Altar to begin every sunrise in prayer.
